course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: several technology-related subjects linked to the future exercise of the profession

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and give a commercial vision to the knowledge from other technological subjects.
Put into practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Relate with real external agents to the University (suppliers, clients, financial entities...) and know the organizations and support instruments for entrepreneurs.
Foster the entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.

syllabus_topics: Creation of companies: the business plan and technology
Generalities: objectives, methodology, and work plan of the subject.
The process of creating a technological micro-company: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, study approach, and instruments.
Income statement (or profit and loss) and cash flow statement (or receipts and payments).
assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, if a minimum attendance of 75% is met, the final grade is calculated as NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA x 0.5 + EXA_FIN x 0.3 + PA x 0.2. If this formula yields at least 5 points, the subject is approved. Failure to meet the minimum attendance results in a "No Presentado" (No Show) grade. For extraordinary assessments, the final grade is calculated as NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA x 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA x 0.4, requiring at least 5 points to pass. For extraordinary exams, students must notify the professor at least 4 weeks in advance and submit the final business plan at least 48 hours before the exam.
